system.description:
Move forward to grab at your opponent. The target makes a Physical Resistance roll. On failure they suffer this Skills effects. This Skill gains a different effect based on its Trigger.

  • Light Trigger: The target takes 5 damage, and becomes Grappled.
  • Heavy Trigger: The target takes damage equal to [Soul + 3] and becomes [Staggered]. If you were grappling the target the grapple is released.
  • Grab Trigger: Can only be used if the Trigger was successful. The target is dealt [2 x Soul] damage and you maintain your grapple on them.
